value.name: Lucia agrees to tell her brother
value.description: Asha tells Lucia she must inform her brother about the letter soon, and Lucia accepts that she should hear it from her.
evidence: "There is one more thing," Asha said. "You need to tell your brother about this letter. Not tonight. But soon. Before I have to. I would rather he hear it from you."
"He will think a lot of things. None of them will be true and none of them will matter in court. But they will matter at this table for the rest of your life."
"Will you be there when I tell him."
"Yes," Asha said. "If you want me to be."

value.name: They set Friday for the disclosure
value.description: Asha and Lucia agree to wait until Friday to tell Lucia's brother about the letter.

value.name: Asha gains three days to find codicil
value.description: Asha realizes she has three more days to locate the codicil, which she believes will determine whether the case ends cleanly.
evidence: That gave Asha three more days to find the codicil itself, which was, she had begun to suspect, going to be the difference between this story ending cleanly and ending the way most of her cases did, which was with everyone alive but no one quite speaking.

value.name: Successor firm returns archive findings
value.description: The successor firm calls Asha back and a young apologetic paralegal named Marcus reports what he found in the physical archive.
evidence: The next morning the successor firm called back.
A paralegal named Marcus, who sounded young and who sounded apologetic.

value.name: Marcus finds Serrano file and notes
value.description: Marcus says the archive contains a Serrano file with the executed will, correspondence, and Pinsky's handwritten notes from a September meeting.
evidence: He had gone through the physical archive.

It contained the executed will from eleven years ago, two pieces of correspondence, and a folder marked September, which contained Mr. Pinsky's handwritten notes from a client meeting on September twelfth

value.name: Notes mention codicil executed
value.description: The handwritten notes include an entry stating that a codicil was executed with two witnesses and returned to the client.
evidence: including the phrase "codicil executed, two witnesses, original to client per instruction."

value.name: Asha questions retention of original
value.description: Asha repeats the phrase 'per instruction' and begins pressing Marcus about whether Pinsky kept the original document.
